stages.name: Impermanence Heron

effects.description: 60s after the battle starts, after a Resonator's attacks hit an enemy, that enemy takes 5% more total DMG. This value increases by 5% every 5s, up to a maximum of 60%.
Enemies' All-Attribute RES is increased by 15%. This effect does not affect the Electro DMG and Spectro DMG they take.

Casting Intro Skill increases the total DMG dealt by all Resonators in the team by 15% for 20s. When a Resonator inflicts Electro Flare, they deal 55% more total DMG for 20s. When a Resonator triggers Unison Response, they deal 50% more total Electro DMG for 20s.

selectableBuffs.name: General Enhancement
selectableBuffs.description: • Enemies take 20% more total DMG.• Enemies take 20% more total Basic Attack DMG.

selectableBuffs.name: Enhancement: Negative Status
selectableBuffs.description: • When inflicted with Negative Statuses, the target takes 25% more total DMG and an additional 30% more total Electro DMG for 30s.

selectableBuffs.name: Basic DMG Enhancement
selectableBuffs.description: • Total Echo Skill DMG is increased by 40%.• When a Resonator triggers Unison Response, they deal 55% more total DMG for 30s.• Resonators deal 11% more total DMG upon gaining a Shield for 2s, stacking up to 5 times. The stacks are cleared when the Resonator is switched out.

selectableBuffs.name: Enhancement: Tune Break
selectableBuffs.description: • Inflicting Tunability - Shifting increases the total DMG dealt by all Resonators in the team by 25% for 30s.• Inflicting Hack - Shifting increases total DMG dealt by the Resonator by 30% for 30s.

effects.name: Stability Accords
effects.description: For 15s after defeating Inferno Rider, all Resonators in the team are immune to damage and interruptions.

effects.name: Singularity Expansion
effects.description: • All Stability Accords Mechanics • Inferno Rider's attacks inflict Resonators with a burning effect on hit, dealing Fusion DMG over time. This DMG is reduced by 90% while the target's HP is above 50% or the target has a Shield.

effects.name: Round 2 Onwards - Additional Infections
effects.description: • Inferno Rider deals Fusion DMG over time to nearby resonator not in mid-air. This DMG is reduced by 90% while the target's HP is above 50% or the target has a Shield.

effects.name: Stability Accords
effects.description: For 15s after defeating Forbidden Bastion, all Resonators in the team are immune to damage and interruptions.

effects.name: Singularity Expansion
effects.description: • All Stability Accords Mechanics • Dodge Counter restores 10 points of Resonance Energy on hit and additionally reduces 20% of the target's Max Vibration Strength. This effect has a 2s cooldown.

effects.name: Round 2 Onwards - Additional Infections
effects.description: • Forbidden Bastion's ATK is increased by 30%.

effects.name: Stability Accords
effects.description: For 15s after defeating Calamity Effigy, all Resonators in the team are immune to damage and interruptions.

effects.name: Singularity Expansion
effects.description: • All Stability Accords Mechanics • Dodge Counter grants the Resonator 2 stacks of Unstoppable on hit, neutralizing incoming interruptions and control effects. Unstoppable stacks up to 2 times. Taking a hit removes 1 stack, and this reduction can trigger up to once per second.

effects.name: Round 2 Onwards - Additional Infections
effects.description: • Calamity Effigy's ATK is increased by 40%. Effect is disabled while it is inflicted with Electro Flare.

effects.description: - For 15s after defeating a Matrix Mimic, all Resonators in the team are immune to all types of damage and interruptions. - Matrix Mimic has equal RES to all attribute DMG. Dealing damage to it yields 1.1x points.
